summary: No actionable correctness blocker found in xswap-radix-hole-reclaim. In mm/swapfile.c and mm/swap.h, 2-level RCU radix chunks provide lockless O(1) cluster lookup via si->cluster_dir[chunk_idx] with zero global lock holds. Descriptors remain strictly 56 bytes with 4096-aligned chunk allocation, eliminating plain-mode metadata overhead. Atomic decrement atomic_dec_and_test(&chunk->live_clusters) tracks empty interior chunks without si->xswap_lock. Interior hole reclamation unlinks chunks under si->xswap_lock and frees memory asynchronously via kfree_rcu(), avoiding lock inversion and synchronize_rcu() latency stalls. Chunk 0 is permanently guarded. Checkpatch clean with 0 errors and 0 warnings.
